name: Snowflake
summary: Run queries and load Parquet partitions into Snowflake with COPY INTO from a stage. Loads are idempotent by partition and revision (ADR 0012).

fields.name: private_key
fields.label: Private key (PEM)
fields.help: The private half of the key pair registered on the Snowflake user.

fields.name: private_key_passphrase
fields.label: Private key passphrase
fields.help: Only for an encrypted private key.

fields.name: oauth_access_token
fields.label: OAuth access token
fields.help: Issued by your identity provider or by Snowflake OAuth; short-lived.

settings.name: account
settings.label: Account
settings.help: Everything before .snowflakecomputing.com in the account URL.

settings.name: stage
settings.label: Stage for loads
settings.help: A named stage that holds the Parquet files for COPY INTO.

operators.summary: Run a SQL statement and keep the result as Parquet.
Load Parquet from a stage with COPY INTO, once per partition and revision.

notes: An external stage reads from S3, Google Cloud Storage or Azure Blob; add that store's connector domains to the same egress approval. Ogun does not create the stage or the target table.
